description: Export a run as a governance evidence pack: the signed receipt, every entry, a roll-up of the nodes consulted (with pinned versions/hashes), an independent hash-chain + Merkle integrity self-check, and a coversheet mapping the receipt to the record-keeping obligations it supports (EU AI Act Art. 12/26, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF). A sealed run is readable by id; a still-open run's draft pack needs your api_key.

api_key.description: Optional: your Bidda key, required for a still-open (unsealed) run.

name: get_audit_pack
